title: LTI System
text: Use linear time invariant system model object in Simulink, 1 input, 1 output, {Pade order (for linearization)} sets Order of Pade approximation; {LTI system variable} sets the linear system dynamic and {Initial states (state-space only)} sets the initial state values for state-space model. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial states (state-space only)
params.values: Initial state values for state-space model [] (default) | vector | scalar

params.name: Pade order (for linearization)
params.values: Order of Pade approximation 0 (default) | positive integer | vector
